installCommand: mkdir -p .probe-home && env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$PWD/.probe-home" npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --userconfig="$PWD/.probe-home/.npmrc" --globalconfig=/dev/null --cache "$PWD/.probe-cache"
buildCommand: bash scripts/native-build/check-production-target.sh && env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$PWD/.probe-home" bash scripts/native-build/build-native.sh && npm run build
